integrity.computational_scope: exhaustive exact checks at orders 6, 10, 14, 15; not an infinite proof
integrity.mathematical_proof: self-contained rational cyclotomic-kernel argument and exact combinatorial enumeration
integrity.novelty_limit: An equivalent older tabulation in spectral sampling, coding or vanishing-sum literature cannot be ruled out.
integrity.validation: self-review; no independent audit or external validation

scientific_limitations: Applies only to cyclic groups of order pq with p and q distinct primes and to convolution idempotents with zero-one Fourier multipliers.
Does not classify prime-power or three-prime-factor cyclic groups or idempotents with generalized coefficients.
The primitive-root zero relation used in the proof is classical; the claimed new result is the exact joint zero-set and spectral-rank weighted enumeration.
title: Complete zero-set and size enumeration for squarefree semiprime convolution idempotents
